title: Pickpocket's kill target is not restricted to gear with Energy cost <= 1
expected: packages/riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/effects-damage.ts:159-186 — the richMatch regex captures " with Energy cost no more than [1]" into withClause (group 2), but the gear branch (line 166-186) builds gearTarget from targetStr only (controller/quantity) and returns at line 186 without ever reading withClause. No energyCost filter is attached. Verified by running parseAbilities on Pickpocket's rulesText: output is {type:"kill", target:{type:"gear"}} with no filter, matching the observed behavior (Sun Disc cost 2 offered/killed). Card file pickpocket.ts has no explicit abilities override, so the parsed result is what the engine uses.
observed: choose-target pendingChoice options listed both Orb of Regret (cost 1) AND Sun Disc (cost 2). In a second game with only Sun Disc (cost 2) on board, accepting the opt-in auto-killed Sun Disc (moved to trash) and created a Gold token. Parsed effect is {type:kill,target:{type:gear}} with no cost filter.

history.note: kill-gear parser branch now reads the 'with Energy cost no more than [N]' clause into an energyCost lte filter

resolution.note: kill-gear parser branch now reads the 'with Energy cost no more than [N]' clause into an energyCost lte filter
